cases.summary: A narrated three-slide talk. The speaker says product names that are also written on the slides, so a speech-to-text misspelling can be fixed from the screen.
speech: Welcome to the Widget Frobnicator, release four point two.
First, open the dashboard and go to the cache settings.
Now raise the cache size to one gigabyte and restart the Frobnicator.

expect.notes: The agent should spell 'Frobnicator' as on the slides in corrections.json.

cases.summary: The same kind of narration with a loud music bed under it, the case where voice-activity filtering can drop all the speech.
speech: This is the quarterly review. Revenue is up twelve percent.
Next, we will hire two engineers before the end of the year.

expect.speech_attempts: 1 or 2 (a second attempt without the VAD filter when the first finds nothing)
expect.notes: Never a quiet frames-only document: a transcript, or needs_decision.

cases.summary: Slides with an audio track that carries nothing (a muted microphone).

expect.notes: The agent must ask the user, not pick --allow-frames-only by itself.
